_readme: Registry of official/verified sources IndiaMetrix intends to use. No indicator data is populated from these yet — this is a reference list for Phase 2 onward. Add entries here before wiring any indicator to a source_id.

sources.name: Census of India
sources.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
sources.notes: Most recent full census: 2011. The 2021 census was delayed.

sources.name: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
sources.notes: Publishes NSS/PLFS surveys, GDP estimates, and national accounts data.

sources.name: Reserve Bank of India
sources.notes: Publishes banking, credit, inflation and monetary data.

sources.name: NITI Aayog
sources.notes: Publishes the SDG India Index and policy/indicator dashboards.

sources.name: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India
sources.notes: Aggregator of datasets published by various ministries.

sources.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sources.notes: Publishes NFHS survey data and health statistics.

sources.name: National Crime Records Bureau
sources.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

sources.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
sources.notes: Digital India programme data and reports.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data
sources.notes: Used for India-vs-World country comparisons; internationally standardized.

sources.name: United Nations Data (UN Statistics Division)
sources.notes: Used for cross-country demographic and development comparisons.
